method: Manual review of the 15 saved extraction outputs. This is a post-run exploratory audit, not a blinded or automated independent test. Allows equivalent date/time expressions including omission of on/at and propagation of am/pm through a time range. Requires the complete title and correct assignment to date_text and time_text.

135M.note: Haircut next Friday at 4pm is additionally accepted despite omitting at. Other failures include copying November 5 from an example, dropping Alex from Call Alex, missing fields, and swapping date/time phrases.

360M.note: Dinner at 7pm fails: at 7pm was assigned to date_text with a null time_text. All other outputs retain the title and semantically equivalent date/time phrases. This subset does not test ambiguity, recurrence, duration, overnight handling, or informal abbreviations.
